comparators.base_form: Selective diagonal state-space recurrence h_t = A_t h_{t-1} + B_t x_t, y_t = C_t h_t with input-dependent diagonal A_t (Mamba, Gu & Dao 2023), here with B = 0 and nonzero initial state
comparators.parameter_mapping: Card beam B = {pi : h_pi > 0}. Card m_pi = k - h_pi. Card s'(pi) = log prior + (h_pi - h_max) log rho, which ranks identically. Card newborn m = k - 1 is h = 1 after a reset. Card missed_now = 1 - b_pi. Card T gives the feature-map table b and the read selector C(q). Card lambda gives the initial state w_0. rho = (1 - eps + eps/V)/(eps/V). K is the sparsity budget.
comparators.read: At key q: if S = {pi : h_pi > 0} is nonempty, p(y) = eps/V + (1 - eps) sum_{pi in S} w_pi [P_pi(q) = y] / sum_{pi in S} w_pi; otherwise p(y) = 1/V. Top-1 is the argmax, ties to the smallest token.

transformations.what: Run over paired tokens (c, x_t) formed from the alternating key/value stream.
Per-channel input feature b_pi(c, x) = [T-composition P_pi(c) = x] from the fixed library table; it gives A_t = diag(rho^{b}) and the query-selected one-hot read C(q).
Top-K state-selected mask over channels with h > 0, with masked channels returned to the initial state; the read is restricted to the support h > 0.
The read is divided by the total live mass sum_{h > 0} w and mixed with the fixed eps/V floor.

comparators.update: At a value token x_t with pending key c, for every pi in Pi_D: w_pi <- rho^{b_pi} w_pi, with b_pi = [P_pi(c) = x_t] and w_0 = lambda-prior(pi); equivalently h_pi <- h_pi + b_pi. Then keep the K channels with h_pi > 0 of largest log prior(pi) + h_pi log rho, ties to b_pi = 1 and then the D15 order. Reset every other channel to h_pi = 0, i.e. w_pi = prior(pi). At a key token, set c <- x_t with no state change.

comparators.base_form: Diagonal multiplicative recurrence w_t = diag(l(x_t)) w_{t-1} (exact sequential Bayesian model averaging / HMM forward filter with identity transition), as stated in the card's own known_relatives
comparators.parameter_mapping: Same as topk_selective_diag_ssm, with K >= |Pi_D| so the top-K mask never binds.
comparators.read: p(y) = eps/V + (1 - eps) sum_{pi : h_pi > 0} w_pi [P_pi(q) = y] / sum_{pi : h_pi > 0} w_pi; uniform if no channel has h > 0.

transformations.what: Hit indicator per program from the library table.
Read restricted to channels with at least one hit.
Division by the live mass, plus the eps/V floor.

comparators.update: For every pi in Pi_D: w_pi <- rho^{[P_pi(c) = x_t]} w_pi from w_0 = prior(pi), with no pruning.

comparisons.comparator: selective diagonal SSM over program channels, A_t = diag(rho^[P_pi(c)=x_t]), B = 0, w_0 = prior; top-K state mask with reset to w_0; normalized one-hot read plus eps/V floor
comparisons.reference: selective diagonal state-space recurrence, Mamba (Gu & Dao 2023)

comparisons.comparator: unpruned diagonal multiplicative recurrence (exact sequential Bayesian model averaging), normalized read over channels with h > 0
comparisons.reference: HMM forward filter with identity transition / sequential BMA, w_t = diag(l(x_t)) w_{t-1}

reduction_check.notes: Next-token probabilities are compared at every step; after value tokens both sides emit the uniform vector. 256 of 401 sequences had the top-K mask binding (exact BMA differs there). K, eps, T and lambda are random, including K = |Pi_D|; the toy stream is included. No rescaling.
